author: XBOX
description:
Digital pre-orders and physical edition pre-orders are now available.

This entry in the Atelier series focuses on tying in alchemy to deepen every aspect of the game. Synthesized items can now be used for more than just combat. They will assist you during exploration and base-building, and will help shape the very path of your adventure. Karia can also eat synthesized items to change both her appearance and abilities. Synthesize items, use them on your adventure, and eat them. This cycle will tie everything together in this new evolution of the Atelier series.

In Hozy, you'll clean, paint, and decorate to restore a once-thriving neighbourhood. With deeply satisfying tools and tactile item interactions, work at your own pace to create something truly beautiful.

Renovate each space, furnish it on behalf of its occupant, and create a cozy home. When you're done with the main story, play through reimagined versions in Game Plus Mode for a completely fresh take on each room. Then, combine your favourite furniture and create a customised space in Sandbox Mode - the possibilties are endless!

description:
Dig by day. Defend by night. Survive at all costs!

https://www.xbox.com/games/store/the-spotter-dig-or-die/9n3cr0sq9w9g\n\n

Welcome to the worst gas station in Nevada, where mutant hordes are knocking at your door and the fate of the world might just depend on you!

Dig deep underground to uncover valuable resources, upgrade your equipment, and transform your rusty outpost into an unstoppable fortress. But don’t get too comfortable! When night falls, hordes of mutants come crawling out of the wasteland, and it’s up to you to hold the line.

Build deadly defenses, unlock powerful weapons, discover game-changing roguelike artifacts, and take control of your turrets to fight back against the chaos.

And remember, you’re not just fighting to survive. You’ve got a broken receiver to repair and a very important message from the President to catch!

author: XBOX
description:
Kingdom of Night is an 80s-inspired isometric action RPG where coming-of-age drama meets cosmic horror.

When a satanic cult unleashes the ancient evil Baphomet on the small town of Miami, Arizona, high school student John must fight through a night of demonic chaos to rescue his friends before the town is lost forever.

Choose from five distinct classes: Barbarian, Knight, Rogue, Necromancer, or Sorcerer, and customize your build with expansive skill trees, powerful loot, and unique equipment. Explore the town freely, battle terrifying Demon Generals in any order, uncover the stories of Miami's residents, and descend into massive demon lairs.

Face the apocalypse alone or team up with a friend in two-player local co-op to save Miami before the night ends.

Friday night just became the end of the world.

The Dawnbreaker CBT starts December 3. Pre-register now.
Standing vigilant, the Oathblade bears witness to every rise, fall, and legacy across these seas.

Once, the Five Noble Houses swore their undying fealty to this royal blade—an oath now shattered and lost to time.

The Young Baron Michael, resolved to reclaim his house’s lost order, is relentlessly hunted by his sworn rival, Torino;
The Empress Ravenscar, bound by her forebears’ unfinished mission, takes up the new King’s mantle to become the blade of Hegney;

And what of the illustrious names that fell alongside the Mad King—does anyone still remember them today?

The reign of the Mad King has ended. Yet from the dying embers, a new flame rises.
